elements.text: We're glad you took a few minutes for yourself to complete this assessment.
That's already a meaningful first step.
This report reflects your responses across nine areas of everyday student life. There's
no right or wrong here, it's simply a snapshot to help you understand what's feeling
heavy right now, and where things are already going well.
